# TeddyPups U.A.E.

> Premium teacup puppies in Dubai. Meet your new best friend in our Dubai showroom, or order a rare miniature breed from trusted breeders worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](/): every puppy is family
- [Available puppies](/puppies): real photos of the actual puppy, with filters by breed and boy or girl
- [Gone home](/gone-home): puppies that have already joined a loving family
- [Happy families](/happy-families): moments shared by families who welcomed a Teddy Pup
- [How it works](/how-it-works): meeting a puppy in Dubai or ordering one upon request, delivery and our promise
- [Questions & answers](/faq): vaccinations, imports, delivery and help after your puppy comes home
- [Visit & contact](/contact): write to us or visit the Downtown Dubai showroom
